rows.grounds: compound of anuloma and vilomena with internal sandhi; indicates bidirectional sequence
locative indicating the matrix within which recitation occurs

items.question: In what manner must the wise practitioner recite the mantra within the mātṛkā?
premises: The recitation proceeds in forward and reverse order.
The recitation takes place within the mātṛkā.
A wise practitioner is the agent of this recitation.
items.inference: Therefore the wise practitioner should recite the mantra within the mātṛkā in both forward and reverse order.
items.plain_english: The wise one should recite it within the mātṛkā in forward and reverse order.
